concept.reason: Inspected whole skeleton casts and neotype skull photograph provide necessary shape evidence; no extra generated concept needed.

scope: Original stylized Coelophysis bauri living reconstruction; AMNH 7224 skull photograph anchors narrow muzzle, Denver mounted casts anchor whole-body silhouette. Not a specimen scan.

scientific_limits.en: Soft tissues, color, pose and body width are reconstruction choices. Fossil compression and restored casts are not exact living dimensions. No cannibalism claim.
scientific_limits.zh: 软组织、颜色、姿态及体宽是复原选择；化石压扁和复原铸模不等于精确活体尺寸。不声称同类相食。

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: slender ribbonlike trunk, long neck and narrow tooth-bearing muzzle. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：细长躯干、长颈与狭窄有齿吻部。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block slender ribbonlike trunk, long neck and narrow tooth-bearing muzzle with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织细长躯干、长颈与狭窄有齿吻部；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

material_profile: palette-only static original geometry, muted earth tones; no copied photograph texture
pose: Balanced biped stance, mildly S-curved long neck, long tapering counterbalance tail off ground; flexed arms separated from torso, palms inward.

scale.basis: 2.6 m working length within AMNH approximate 8–10 ft range. Width and height are artistic estimates, not specimen measurements.
scale.tolerance: length ±10%; width/height are design targets not fossil measurements

shape_requirements: Preserve original slender ribbonlike trunk, long neck and narrow tooth-bearing muzzle as one diagnostic combination. No stocky tyrannosaur torso or shortened thick neck.
Long low wedge-shaped head, narrow jaws with a modest readable row of small teeth; large lateral eye region but no exposed skull holes in living surface.
Long thin neck transitions smoothly to slim chest and pelvis; elongated tail with gradual taper, not a short stumpy tail.
Slender long hindlimbs and separate clawed toes; forelimbs readable with grasping hands, never bird wings or pronated human palms.
Use profile/loft topology and deliberate joints; no unmodified primitive chain. Avoid unnecessary tiny teeth or overly skeletal shrinkwrap.
gray_model_gate: Low-cost side/front/oblique self-check before polish; original shape combination must read before final geometry.
final_evidence: Four exact-export views front/side/top/perspective; perspective may equal preview. Two isolated rebuilds, official glTF and pinned viewer gates, fresh independent QA; no inferred GPU/scene/user acceptance.
